question: How many times did Michael Schumacher won from races hosted in Sepang International Circuit?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM results AS r
JOIN drivers AS d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races AS ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN circuitDetails AS c ON ra.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE d.forename = 'Michael'
  AND d.surname = 'Schumacher'
  AND c.name = 'Sepang International Circuit'
  AND r.position = 1
